angularDiameterSource: No angular diameter is measured: this is the record's radius at the Gaia distance.
distanceSource: Gaia DR3 source 3009908378049913216: parallax 37.2539 +/- 0.0195 mas (RUWE 0.92), inverted to 26.8429 pc with no zero-point correction.
radiusSource: Temperature 6076 +180/-92 K from the high-resolution spectroscopic analysis of Baburaj et al. (2026, arXiv:2608.15912), and stellar mass 1.20 +/- 0.06 solar masses from their Table 1. Radius 1.25 +/- 0.06 solar radii from Kervella et al. (2004), the value Franson et al. (2023, arXiv:2302.05420) adopt: 869,625 km at 695,700 km per solar radius. GM from 1.20 solar masses times the JPL solar GM. presentationUp: the display axis (celestial north at the star) is up; no spin axis is measured on the sky.
effectiveTemperatureSource: 6076 +180/-92 K, Baburaj et al. (2026), section 5.1, https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.15912
surfaceGravitySource: log g from the mass and radius in packages/astronomy/data/bodies/af-lep.json (sources in its physicalNotes), log10(GM/R^2) in cgs: 4.323, rounded to two decimals
spectralTypeSource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of AF Lep (pscomppars): spectral type F8, from Denis et al. 2025 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2025A&A...696A...6D/abstract)
metallicitySource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of AF Lep (pscomppars): [Fe/H] 0.19 dex, from Franson et al. 2023 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2023ApJ...950L..19F/abstract)
luminositySource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of AF Lep (pscomppars): log10 of the luminosity in solar units 0.29, from Turnbull 2015 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2015arXiv151001731T/abstract)
ageSource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of AF Lep (pscomppars): age 0.024 Gyr, from Franson et al. 2023 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2023ApJ...950L..19F/abstract)
rotationPeriodSource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of AF Lep (pscomppars): rotation period 0.966 d, from De Rosa et al. 2023 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2023A&A...672A..94D/abstract)
projectedRotationSpeedSource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of AF Lep (pscomppars): projected rotation speed 54.7 km/s, from Mesa et al. 2023 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2023A&A...672A..93M/abstract)
spinInclinationSource: Computed here from this record's rotation period, projected rotation speed and radius (1.25 solar radii): sin i = v sin i × P / (2πR) = 0.836. Not a measurement of the axis: the three numbers come from different papers.

shape.qualification: A sphere at the published radius. The star's disc is not resolved; its color is Gaia's spectrum of it.
